style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, warm daylight
motion_rule: the camera orbits her without stopping and reverses at 2.25, 4.15 and 7.4, so the packed rails of fur coats and the shelves of folders tear past behind her; she walks down the aisle in EVERY beat and throws a coat, a hanger or a box with her whole body, arms and wings wide, in EVERY beat; the courier moth crosses through the lens hauling folders in EVERY beat; new shot size every beat; she fills half the frame height; one action per beat; no push in, no rack focus
character: a plump grey clothes moth in a rich brown mink coat with a huge lush collar chewed ragged, powdery wings, feathered antennae
second_characters: ONE lean moth in a headset, always within a wing of the lens, hauling folders through the frame in every beat
props: ONE dark fur coat on a hanger that she carries and throws; ONE stack of folders in the courier's arms
environment: a packed storage room of a bank, a long aisle between rails crammed with fur coats and shelves stacked with folders, tall daylight windows, dust burning in the sun

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty female voice, flat and bored, even 4.4 syllables/sec, every word stretched to its own window
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, no silent lead-in; 0.0-4.15 one breath, short breath at 4.15, 4.15-7.4 one breath; after 7.4 only sfx
audio.pronunciation: BA-bush-ki-nu, SHU-bu, do-YE-la, BA-bush-ku, do-YE-li, dol-GHI, za-TO, PLA-tit, i-po-TE-ke
audio.lip_sync: her mouth opens on every syllable in every spoken beat, never a voice over
audio.sfx: hangers screeching along the rails, fur ripping, paper tearing, a box bursting at 4.6, a rail crashing down at 8.8
